...detesting as he said the insatiable impudency of a prostitute Stale.

glosses: Any decoy, either stuffed or manufactured.

examples.text: 'Tis the living bird that makes the best stale to draw others into the net.
If my live birds aren't all drownded and my stales spoiled.

glosses: To serve as a decoy, to lure.

examples.text: The eye...Doth serue to stale her here and there where she doth come and go.
